claim: Declares what the character is for in the story so the pipeline can spend on them — prompt priority, face-weight budget, how often they anchor a shot. A director sets it once per character to stop an extra eating the token budget that belongs to the lead.
not_visual: Role is a budget and priority setting, not a look. With the subject sentence and seed held fixed, a lead and an extra are the same drawing; the only way to make the panels differ is to smuggle in shot size, framing or wardrobe, which belong to other variables. Nothing here changes pixels on its own.
